patch 8.2.3467: CursorHoldI event interferes with "CTRL-G U"

Problem:    CursorHoldI event interferes with "CTRL-G U". (Naohiro Ono)
Solution:   Restore the flag for "CTRL-G U" after triggering CursorHoldI.
            (closes #8937)
